eye.name: Light (eye)
eye.job: Photoreceptors. Light falling here drives the Light relay.

light.name: Light relay
light.job: Passes light to both choice lobes through weak synapses that can learn. A touch mutes it.

touch.name: Touch
touch.job: Touch relays. They wake the Swim choice, the Touch gate and the Alarm.

tgate.name: Touch gate
tgate.job: Inhibitory. While the skin is touched it silences the Light relay.

food.name: Food
food.job: Food relays. They drive the Feed choice and the VTA.

swim.name: Swim choice
swim.job: The decision to swim. Its cells excite each other, so one push latches it on.

gate.name: Swim gate
gate.job: Inhibitory. While the choice is on, it switches the Swim brake off.

brake.name: Swim brake
brake.job: Always firing, holding the Command silent until the gate lets go.

command.name: Command
command.job: Released from the brake, it drives both sides of the tail.

rhythmL.name: Rhythm L
rhythmL.job: Half of the swim rhythm: bursts until its synapses tire, inhibiting the other side meanwhile.

rhythmR.name: Rhythm R
rhythmR.job: The other half. The two sides take turns: that alternation is the stroke.

feed.name: Feed choice
feed.job: The decision to feed. A mirror of the Swim choice.

fgate.name: Feed gate
fgate.job: Inhibitory. While the Feed choice is on, it switches the Feed brake off.

fbrake.name: Feed brake
fbrake.job: Always firing, holding the pump still until the gate lets go.

pump.name: Feed pump
pump.job: Released, it pulses: bursts that ignite, tire out and recover.

cS.name: Competition S
cS.job: Driven by the Swim choice; inhibits the Feed choice.

cF.name: Competition F
cF.job: Driven by the Feed choice; inhibits the Swim choice. Only one choice can win.

alarm.name: Alarm (LC)
alarm.job: Touch wakes it. Noradrenaline into both lobes and the tail: louder strokes.

bf.name: Basal forebrain
bf.job: Light wakes it. Acetylcholine into the tail: faster strokes.

raphe.name: Raphe
raphe.job: Swimming wakes it. Serotonin slowly tires the Swim choice: a long swim gives up.

sraphe.name: Raphe (feeding)
sraphe.job: Feeding wakes it. Serotonin tires the Feed choice: fullness after ~8 s.

vta.name: VTA
vta.job: Food wakes it. Dopamine into the Feed choice lets Light → Feed learn.
